messages:
maria (infra): Heads-up — starting a GPU quota request for a small Zurich edge cluster to support a pilot workload. Target: 8x A100s (training/bench) + 16x T4s (staging). Need someone to own procurement + basic network/PE checks. Goal: availability in ~2 weeks.

raj.k: I can own the quota ticket if you confirm region and project. Which exact region code are we asking for? zurich is usually europe-west6 in our mapping, right? Also: will these be preemptible / reserved?

maria (infra): Project = redwood-eu-edge, region = europe-west6 (Zurich). Prefer non-preemptible for the A100s (pilot needs stability); T4s can be preemptible. Will request a temporary reservation (capacity hold) for the first 30 days to validate perf.

beno: Drafting request now. Putting the rough payload here so we can copy to cloud console/support ticket: 
```
GPU quota request:
project: redwood-eu-edge
region: europe-west6
resources:
  - accelerator: nvidia-a100-40gb
    count: 8
  - accelerator: nvidia-t4
    count: 16
reason: Pilot cluster bring-up for Zurich edge. Need capacity hold for 30d for validation. Contact: maria@redwood.com, raj.k@redwood.com
```
Also running `gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones=europe-west6-*` to verify SKUs; will paste exact SKU names in the ticket.

zoe (costs): Quick cost FYI (ballpark): A100 pool ~ $8k-12k/GPU-month depending on commitment/market; 8x is material. T4s are cheap for staging. If we flip to reserved term or committed use discount we can drop unit cost ~20-30%. Need finance ok before we approve long-lived reservation.

maria (infra): Noted. For now request capacity hold for 30 days and mark as pilot so we can evaluate. Finance: @zoe (costs) — can you put a short note in the ticket with approver names and an estimated spend cap?

zoe (costs): Will do. I’ll add: approvers = finance-leads + eng-vp. Cap = $120k/month hard cap for pilot. If quota approved we only enable resources we need; we won't spin all GPUs immediately.

infra-bot: Ticket created: CP-12345 (GCP quota increase request) — status: submitted to GCP support. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CP-12345

gcp-support: Thanks for the submission. ETA for approval is 3-7 business days depending on capacity in europe-west6. For reservation/hold we need the following from you:
- Exact accelerator SKU (from `gcloud compute accelerator-types list`)
- Expected VM types (n1-standard-32 / a2-highgpu etc)
- A short architecture note confirming VPC / peering needs
- Contact for legal/compliance if required for enterprise billing

raj.k: Copying the commands I used to enumerate SKUs earlier so we don't mismatch: 
```
# list accelerators in region
gcloud compute accelerator-types list --filter="zone:( europe-west6-* )" --project=redwood-eu-edge
```
Will attach output to CP-12345.

beno: Also adding the network checklist for the ticket (so support can see upstream deps): 
- VPC: redwood-eu-zurich-vpc created
- Subnets: three subnets (control, workloads, mgmt) / appropriate CIDRs
- Firewall: allow node <-> controlplane (port 22, 10250, 2379)
- Peering: cloud-router / BGP planned to prod backbone (AS prep)
- MTU: ensure jumbo frames enabled for RDMA overlays (if we enable NCCL RDMA)

maria (infra): Good list. Also note we need these verification steps once quota is granted and nodes are up: 
1) GPU driver & runtime: `ssh node && sudo nvidia-smi`
2) CUDA container smoke: `docker run --gpus all --rm nvidia/cuda:11.8-base nvidia-smi`
3) NCCL check across 2 nodes: run our small all-reduce smoke test (link in runbook)
4) Network MTU & RDMA validation: `ethtool -k` + `ibv_devinfo` if RDMA enabled
5) Node labeling + autoscaler test: create placeholder workload and ensure scale-up/scale-down works

raj.k: Adding a tiny validation script to the infra repo so SRE can run the checks quickly. Patch: infra/ops/validate-zurich-gpu.sh (will PR).

zoe (costs): One more: estimate for 30-day hold with no usage (just reservation) — ask GCP if there's a soft reservation fee or if they will just reserve capacity for us free of charge while we validate. We should avoid paying full commit until after pilot sign-off.

gcp-support: For on-demand quota increases there is no reservation fee; for committed/reserved capacity there are billing implications. We can request a soft hold but that is subject to capacity availability and GCP policy. We will flag it to the capacity team.

maria (infra): Action items: 
- raj.k -> finalize CP-12345 with exact SKUs and VM types (owner)
- beno -> prepare infra PR for terraform module (redwood-zurich-gpu-pool) + validation script
- zoe -> add cost note + approvers in the ticket
- infra-sre -> run validation script once nodes are provisioned (we'll ping in this thread)
Timeline: submit today, follow up mid-week, expect 3-7bd for approval.

beno: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/421 (draft) — includes TF module + smoke tests. Please review.

raj.k: Updated CP-12345 with SKUs: `nvidia-a100-40gb` and `nvidia-t4`. VM families: `a2-highgpu-1g` for A100, `n1-standard-8` for T4. Attached architecture note.

infra-bot: CP-12345 status updated: awaiting capacity team review.

maria (infra): Perfect. If capacity team gives pushback we fall back to a nearby region (europe-west4) for initial validation, but we want Zurich pin for latency testing. Will post final handoff checklist when nodes are green. :white_check_mark:

zoe (costs): I've put the $ cap in the ticket and cc'd finance-leads.

gcp-support: Noted — we've escalated to capacity team and will update CP-12345 with any constraints or ETA.

maria (infra): Thanks everyone — assigning this thread as the main comms for the operation. Ping here when CP-12345 updates or PR is ready for final review.

raj.k: will post updates here. :thumbsup:

beno: quick note for the runbook: include a 'rollback' flow — how we drain / evacuate GPUs and fall back to regional pool. I'll add that to the PR.

maria (infra): Nice. End state: quota approved, TF merged, nodes validated, handoff to SRE + product for pilot. Target close = ~2 weeks.

infra-bot: Thread archived to infra ops workspace after last update.
